note: Byte-exact snapshots of the DRAFT FH* contract schemas the draft CEDAR templates in ../ are generated from. These are development-repo bytes, not released contracts: nothing here is a schema authority, and no w3id URL exists or is claimed for either type. scripts/make_cedar.py reads the snapshot bytes offline and refuses to generate when a snapshot no longer matches its recorded sha256; tests/test_cedar.py recomputes both the sha256 and the git blob hash against this file. Refresh procedure (maintainer-reviewed draft edits only): re-fetch the recorded path from the recorded repository at a named commit, update commit/sha256/size/retrieved here, rerun python scripts/make_cedar.py and review the template diff.

fht.commitSubject: Re-pin the shared imports to v0.6.0; the draft lineage grammar follows #170 (#34)
fht.recordSchemaUrlNote: The draft contract's own schema-property pattern admits this raw-main URL, a future release-tag URL and a future w3id URL; only the raw-main form exists today, so the template pins it. Refreshing the website snapshot is a separate action in that repository; FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools bioheaders/schemas/fht-draft.json is re-pinned to the same 226f923 bytes in the coordinated paired PR.

fhgm.commitSubject: Draft the native FHGM model contract v0.1 (proposal, #204 Option C) (#11)
fhgm.recordSchemaUrlNote: An FHGM model record carries no schema, schemaVersion or checksum field: it is one item of the FHGFF3 x-fhgm-models extension array (docs/FORMAT.md R15 transport, proposal under FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#204) and the enclosing FHGFF3 header keeps the released file identity. No URL is claimed for the model contract itself.
